title: Autumn Arrives
notes: Looking up into a tree in Olympic Forest Park: sunlight shines through heart-shaped leaves already browning at the edges, while the leaves above are still green.
lens: Tamron 25-200mm F/2.8-5.6 Di III VXD G2
alt: A view up into a tree against a blue sky: backlit heart-shaped leaves glow yellow-green with brown, spotted edges among bare twigs, green maple-like leaves hang across the top, and a dark, rough trunk rises on the right.
caption: Autumn Arrives
